mainEntity.name: How much does a minicab from Stanmore HA7 to Heathrow Airport cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard saloon from Stanmore HA7 to Heathrow starts from £55, fixed at the point of booking with no additional charges once the journey is complete.

mainEntity.name: How long does the journey from Stanmore HA7 to Heathrow by minicab take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The typical Stanmore HA7 to Heathrow minicab journey takes between 35 and 55 minutes via the A4140 southbound connecting to the A40 Western Avenue westbound toward the Heathrow terminal approach roads, covering approximately 15 miles.

mainEntity.name: Do LTR Minicab drivers offer meet and greet at Heathrow for Stanmore HA7 passengers?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Our meet and greet service positions your driver inside the arrivals hall with a name board, ready to assist with luggage directly to the vehicle. 45 minutes of complimentary waiting time is included on every airport booking.

mainEntity.name: Are LTR Minicab drivers serving Stanmore HA7 fully licensed?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Every driver holds a valid TfL private hire licence and all vehicles are maintained and insured to private hire standards.

mainEntity.name: Can I book a fixed price Stanmore HA7 to Gatwick or Luton minicab?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Every Stanmore HA7 to Gatwick or Luton minicab booking through LTR Minicab is priced upfront and stays fixed regardless of traffic conditions on the day.
